messages:
Maya (Support): Hey folks — Tenant42 reporting burst of 502/503 on hosted inference endpoint /v1/generate since ~11:05 UTC. They see: `upstream error: 500` and `Gateway timeout` in client logs. Correlation ID: cid=8a7f3c.

Jon (Oncall): Thanks Maya. Can you paste the customer-facing curl/response? Also which region?

Maya (Support): Region: us-west-2. Sample curl they ran:
```bash
curl -i -H \"Authorization: Bearer <key>\" -d '{"model":"redwood-1","input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood-hosted.com/v1/generate
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
Content-Type: application/json
{"error":"upstream error: 500"}
```

Maya (Support): They say ~30% requests fail, others fine. Started happening after config push at 10:59 UTC (per deploy-bot).

Ravi (Eng - Runtime): My first guess: dependency chain timeouts. Any matching errors in control-plane logs (session handshake / policy fetch)?

Lina (Infra): Checking metrics. I see a spike in 95th p95 latency for policy-store reads at 10:58->11:06 UTC and increased 500s from session-manager at 11:02. Let me pull logs.

infra-bot: New incident created: INC-20237 — hosted api 5xx surge (linked to thread 2370001111).

Lina (Infra): Log snippet from session-manager: `Timestamp=2026-03-17T11:03:12Z level=error msg=\"session fetch failed\" err=\"timed out waiting for config-store\" trace=...`

Ravi (Eng - Runtime): That matches. Runtime retries to control plane during request auth/lookup; if session-manager returns 5xx, proxy returns 502/503.

Maya (Support): Tenant42: extremely time-sensitive ML pipeline, asking for ETA and workaround.

Sam (CS): Telling tenant they can retry on 429/5xx; they want a safer mitigation — can we route them to a fallback model or a regional replica?

Ravi (Eng - Runtime): Two mitigation paths: 1) Bypass control-plane session fetch by honoring client-sent session token if present (fast path) — requires config flip on runtime (low-risk). 2) Force fallback routing to a cached policy snapshot (read-only) — requires policy-store toggles.

Lina (Infra): I'm seeing healthy DB connections on config-store but high tail latency to a single replica (db-instance db-config-07). Restarting that replica now (rolling) —ETA ~5m.

Jon (Oncall): Good. While Lina does the restart, Ravi can we enable the runtime fast path toggle? How risky?

Ravi (Eng - Runtime): Fast path toggle: feature flag `runtime.auth.fast_path=true` — flips runtime to skip live session validation and accept signed tokens with local verification. Minor risk: stale revocations for ~5m. I can flip it for us-west-2 only.

Maya (Support): Tenant42 approves the fast-path with revocation caveat. They want us to proceed.

Ravi (Eng - Runtime): Flipping now for region us-west-2. Command: `./flagsctl set runtime.auth.fast_path us-west-2 true --by=Ravi`

infra-bot: Flag applied: runtime.auth.fast_path=true (scope=us-west-2) by Ravi at 2026-03-17T11:08:10Z

Ravi (Eng - Runtime): Monitoring errors... 1m

Lina (Infra): Restart finished for db-config-07 at 11:09:30Z. Latency back to baseline on config-store reads.

Jon (Oncall): Nice. Maya, can you verify with Tenant42 if failures dropped?

Maya (Support): Tenant42 says errors dropped to ~1% and throughput restored. They still saw a couple of 502s during the restart window.

Sam (CS): Customer asks for postmortem and what caused the DB replica tail-latency.

Lina (Infra): Initial hypothesis: IO contention on db-config-07 due to background compaction + sudden spike in policy-store reads after the 10:59 deploy (deploy warmed caches). Will dig deeper.

Ravi (Eng - Runtime): Action items: (1) Roll back temp fast_path flag once all revocations are propagated (T+30m) or after config-store SLAs restored; (2) Add circuit-breaker on session-manager so runtime returns 503 with explanatory message instead of 502 for easier triage; (3) Add more aggressive caching of policy snapshots for high QPS tenants.

Jon (Oncall): I'll own the immediate follow-ups. Lina investigate DB replica health + compaction scheduler. Terraform ticket in infra queue if we need a hotfix to remove noisy compaction windows.

Maya (Support): Raising postmortem request and sender notice to Tenant42. Drafting customer-facing summary.

Tenant42 Ops: Thanks for the quick response — appreciate the region-scoped fast-path. Please keep us updated on root cause and timeline for permanent fix.

Sam (CS): Noted — we'll share a timeline in the postmortem.

Ravi (Eng - Runtime): Marking thread with actions; will post reproducer (if any) and exact flag commands in the incident doc.

Maya (Support): Closing loop here for now — shifting to incident INC-20237 for full postmortem. Adding labels: severity=high, impact=tenant-visible, root-cause=persistent config-store latency. :white_check_mark:
